description: Semantic routing gateway for Sage AI Assistant. Routes user queries to context tools (domain knowledge) and data tools (tenant-scoped data) via semantic search over tool descriptions.

targets.name: sage-mcp-target
targets.description: FastMCP server hosting Sage's context tools (load_claims_workflow_context, load_premium_formulas_context) and data tools (get_product_info, get_claim_details).

notes._auth_explanation: AgentCore Gateway does NOT support GATEWAY_IAM_ROLE for MCP server targets. Only OAUTH (client credentials M2M) is supported. The deploy_gateway.sh script creates the Cognito resource server, M2M client, and AgentCore credential provider automatically.
notes._mcp_runtime_auth: The MCP runtime must be deployed with JWT inbound authorization (deploy_mcp.sh handles this). The Cognito User Pool issues tokens that the MCP runtime validates.
